recovered_evidence: The frozen manifest validator imports an absent active configuration provider before validating four manifest hash fields.
The frozen source does not define configuration authority, canonical bytes, digest construction, profile selection, freshness, or replay provenance.
The validator test is import-only and consumer tests replace the missing provider or validator; they are DIAGNOSTIC_EVIDENCE, not contract proof.

options.name: Explicit immutable local configuration snapshot loaded once per run or manifest operation
options.authority_effect: Binds one read-only, replayable snapshot before manifest construction.
benefits: Prevents mutable or remote configuration reads during validation.
Supports deterministic digest binding and replay.
Permits environment only to select a declared profile before the snapshot boundary.
risks_or_required_approval: The configuration authority root and profile rule must be approved.
The canonical serialization and complete digest set must be approved.
The failure taxonomy and freshness policy must be approved.

options.name: Mutable or remote active-configuration provider consulted during validation
options.authority_effect: Allows mutable or remote state to affect manifest validation.
options.rejection_reason: Conflicts with a deterministic snapshot boundary and leaves replay/freshness authority unresolved.

options.name: Remove active-configuration binding from manifest integrity
options.rejection_reason: Not acceptable for a deterministic manifest-integrity path.

approval_channel: architecture-owner decision supplied in project conversation
